messages:
elaine: Quick update for everyone 1: due to last-minute infra constraints we're delaying the telemetry opt-in flip for new SDK installs by 30 days. TL;DR: new projects keep telemetry off-by-default for now.

harry: Reason? Any customer impact?

elaine: Two things: 1) our rollout circuit for the admin toggle needs another safety guard, and 2) localized docs bundles (i18n) aren't fully baked for the new messaging. No immediate customer break; just delaying the flip.

nora: Docs implications?

elaine: Nora: please pause the in-console banners that reference the flip date. We will update the docs pages to show the new timeline and add a small FAQ about why we delayed.

docs-bot: docs/changeset created: changes/2026-04-10-telemetry-rollout-delay.md preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/changes/2026-04-10-telemetry-rollout-delay

harry: Ops note: feature-flag `sdk.telemetry_default_flip` will remain false for all orgs; ramp plan moved +30d. We'll re-run the smoke tests before any flips.

nora: I'll update the migration guide and add a "what changed" blurb. New link when ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/telemetry-rollout-update

i18n-bot: i18n: localizations in es/fr/ja in progress; ETA +10 days. Will post PRs once translation strings are final.

dev-rel: Customer-facing comms? We should avoid surprising enterprise customers.

customer-success-bot: We've queued targeted emails for flagged enterprise orgs with the new date and rationale. Also prepping support playbook.

elaine: Action items: 1) Docs: add FAQ + localized strings when available (nora). 2) Eng: add an automated pre-flip smoke that verifies admin toggle and banner state (harry). 3) DevRel/CS: draft messages for top 20 customers (dev-rel + customer-success).

harry: I'll add the smoke test ticket and a dashboard panel for `telemetry_flip_precheck`.

nora: I'll hold the banner rollout and publish an updated docs page once translations land.

docs-bot: docs/changeset created: changes/2026-04-10-telemetry-docs-localization.md preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/changes/2026-04-10-telemetry-localize

release-bot: postponed/release-notes: telemetry-default-flip moved: new target 2026-05-11.

dev-rel: small ask: include a short code snippet showing how to opt-in programmatically for users who want to opt-in early.

elaine: Good call. We'll add that snippet to the FAQ and samples repo. Example: `redwood config set --project myproj --telemetry true`.

customer-success-bot: I'll schedule a webinar for customers who want help migrating early.

harry: One more: let's ensure metrics won't misfire when we re-enable the flip. I'll add a canary org to test behavior end-to-end.

elaine: Thanks all. We'll reconvene if anything changes and post the final date once translations and the prechecks pass. END THREAD
